sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished concept sheet for SIX interactive gates in the existing Unfinished Sketchbook 2D side-scrolling metroidvania. Create a wide 3 columns by 2 rows sheet, each equal spacious cell with small number 01..06 only. Input references: first image is actual game screenshot for exact texture, dark torn layered paper terrain, scale and orthographic camera; second image is prior special block sheet for material continuity, improve to environmental gate designs. Match coarse broad matte fibrous paper, charcoal rubbed shadows, gently irregular rounded layered contours, restrained desaturated colors, painterly 2D game sprites with medium detail, no photoreal 3D, no fine noisy linework. Background flat dark charcoal. Each subject fully visible isolated side-on, same ground line, strong usable silhouette, no perspective floor. 01 erasable scribble barrier: vertical charcoal paper ribs crossed with broad smudged graphite strokes; chalky erased gap hints at dash erasing, muted dusty rose underlayer. 02 cuttable graphite vine barrier: broad interwoven olive-gray papery vine ribbons tied at a visibly cuttable central knot, few frayed edges. 03 lever gate: closed vertical pencil-wood slats with chunky hinged paper bands, separate low reachable lever at right connected by a clear short cord. 04 parry gate: folded dark paper door with central dull ochre concentric impact target and a small incoming/reflected ink projectile visual cue, target legible. 05 one-way hatch: horizontal framed thick layered paper lid with broad downward chevron crease and hinged flap, recognizable step-on top access. 06 three-pigment door: slate paper arch framing three obvious recessed circular pigment wells red blue yellow linked by paper channels, closed layered seal behind. Gates feel like intriguing authored world objects, not ordinary wall tiles or metal machinery. Include faint small silhouette of existing cream paper-cloak protagonist next to each gate for scale, 60% gate height. Limit glow to tiny matte inner highlights. No labels except numbers. High-quality cohesive production design board.
